description: Riolering Barendrecht is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by barendrecht.nl. This dataset contains the sewerage that is managed by the municipality of Barendrecht. This dataset is updated daily. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Sewerage Barendrecht" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Riolering, Beheer, Bsarendrecht, Gemeente. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
